d: A shy and brave boy, Nori, lives in the famous amusement park, Nori Park. Nori wants to be the star of rollercoasters and a hero, like his father Dragon Rider, who is the king of racing and looks great on the track rollercoaster in Nori Park.
The Lion King is shot by poachers, as part of Shere Khan the Bengal tiger's plot to overthrow the king from his throne.
The smart and beautiful Sissi does everything to be with her beloved charming Prince Franz, but many people try to stop the couple from living happily ever after

Master Bread faces fresh challenges in Bakery Town, ranging from a massive town-wide rat invasion that eats residents' hair to high-stakes haircut competitions, royal palace drama involving Prince Butterwaffle, and new musical and environmental awareness corners
Dark Joy is brought back to life because of the magic power of the Twin Lake, and he intends to restore the dark power to become the king of Fairy World.
